m: अनु-√ 1. दा (Pass. -दायि) to permit, restore, RV.; to give way, yield, RV.; AV.; to remit, AV.; to pay one out (?), MBh. vii, 9499.
a: अनुदा — {c3c} U. To give back, restore; to yield, grant, remit.

s: tri, (na udAra iti naYsamAsaH nAsti udAro yasmAt iti vA .) atiSayadAtA । adAtA । atimahAn । amahAn । anugatadAraH । yaTA, “yasmin prasIdasi punaH sa BavatyudAro'nudAraSca” । iti mammawaBawwaH ॥
v: anudAra

na॰ na udAraH । atidAtfBinne, amahati ca । nAsti udAro yasmAt 5 ba॰ । atimAtra dAtari, ati mahati ca । anugato dArAn atyA॰ sa॰ । dArAnugate । “yasmin prasIdasi punaH sa BavatyudAro'nudAraSceti kA॰ pra॰ । udAratvAnudAratvayorApAtato viroDaH । udAratvAnugatadAratvAByAM tatparihAraH ।
m: 1. अन्-उदार mfn. niggardly, mean.
2. अनु-दार mfn. adhered to or followed by a wife.
a: अनुदार — a. 1 Not liberal, niggardly; not high or noble. --2 Having none more liberal, very liberal, or great. --3 (अनुगतो दारान्) Adhering to or followed by a wife; यस्मिन्प्रसीदसि पुनः स भवत्युदारोऽनुदारश्च K. P. 4 (used in sense 1 also). --4 Having a suitable or worthy wife (अनुरूपाः दाराः यस्य).

m: अनुदात्तादि n. (in Gr.) a nominal base of which the first syllable is Anudātta.

s: puM, (ut + A + dA + kta, na udAttaH iti naYsamAsaH .) vedagAne nIcasvaraH । yaTA, “udAttaScAnudAttaSca svaritaSca trayaH svarAH” । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (“uccErudAttaH, nIcEranudAttaH, samAhAraH svaritaH” iti pARiniH .)
v: anudAtta

na॰ na udAttaH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । udAttasvaraBinne nIcEruccArite svaraBede । svarAhi triviDAH udAttaH anudAttaH svarita iti BedAt tatra “uccErudAttaH” “nIcEranudAttaH” “samAhAraH svarita” iti ca pA॰ । tAlvAdizu, saBAgezu syAnezUrdDvaBAge nizpannojudAttaH, tatrEva nIcaBAge nizpanno'c anudAttaH । “tasyAdita udAttamardDahasvamiti” pA॰ । yasyAdito'rdDasudAttamantyamanudAttaM tAdfSaH svaraH svaritaH iti” “anudAttaM padamekavarjjamiti” asyEva niGAta nIcAdi saMjYA udAttAnudAttatvAdikaM svaravarRasyEva na tu vyaYjanAnAM, yaToktam SikzAyAm “udAttaScAnudAttaSca svaritaSca svarAstrayaH hfsvodIrGaH plutaSceti kAlatoniyamastvacIti” । “prayatnapreritovAyuryadordDvaBAge pratihato'caM nizpAdayati sa udAttaH । evamaDonizpannojanudAtta iti” Sabdendu॰ । “udAttAnudAttasvaritAnAM sannikarza Eka Srutyam” iti ASva॰ gfhyam ।
m: अन्-उदात्त mfn. not raised, not elevated, not pronounced with the Udātta accent, grave

accentless, having the neutral general tone neither high nor low (i.e. both the grave or non-elevated accent explained by Pāṇini as सन्नतर, q.v. — which immediately precedes the Udātta, and also the general accentless, neutral tone, neither high nor low, explained as एक-श्रुति)
having the one monotonous ordinary intonation which belongs to the generality of syllables in a sentence
अन्-उदात्त m. one of the three accents to be observed in reading the Vedas, the grave accent.
a: अनुदात्त — a. Grave (accent); not elevated or raised (not pronounced with the Udātta accent); उच्चैरुदात्तः, नीचैरनुदात्तः; accentless, having the neutral, general tone; उदात्तश्चानुदात्तश्च स्वरितश्च त्रयः स्वराः; uttered with the grave accent (as a vowel); प्रयत्नप्रेरितो वायुर्यदोर्ध्वभागे प्रतिहतोऽचं निष्पादयति स उदात्तः; एवमधोनिष्पन्नोऽच् अनुदात्तः; ताल्वादिषु सभागेषु स्थानेषु नीचभागे निष्पन्नोऽच् अनुदात्तः; ˚त्तं पदमेकवर्जं Sk. (The term अनुदात्त is used by Pāṇini for the grave accent which immediately precedes the Udātta, and also for the general accentless tone neither high nor low, termed एकश्रुति, the one monotonous intonation belonging to the generality of syllables in a sentence). --त्तः The grave accent. --Comp. --आदिः a nominal base of which the first syllable is अनुदात्त. --इत् a verbal root having for its अनुबंध the grave accent (denoting that it takes the Ātm. terminations only). --उदयं a syllable followed (immediately) by the grave accent. --तर a. more than अनुदात्त; still lower or graver accent, i. e. that which immediately precedes a syllable having the उदात्त or स्वरित accent and is thus more depressed than the ordinary अनुदात्त accent.

m: अन्-उदात्त—तर m. ‘more than Anudātta, still lower in sound than Anudātta’ i.e. the very Anudātta accent (or a syllable having this accent which immediately precedes a syllable having the Udātta or Svarita accent, and is therefore more depressed than the ordinary Anudātta, Pāṇ. i, 2, 31, Sch.), Pāṇ. i, 2, 40, Sch.
अनुदात्तेत् m. a verbal root having for its Anubandha the Anudātta accent to indicate that it takes the Ātmane-pada terminations only
also अनुदात्तोपदेश.
अनुदात्तोदय n. a syllable immediately preceding the Anudātta accent.

m: अन्-उद्भट mfn. not exalted, unassuming.
a: अनुद्भट — a. 1 Not bold; soft, mild. --2 Not exalted or lofty.

m: अन्-उद्धान n. non-abandonment, TāṇḍBr.

non-removal.

m: अन्-उद्धरण n. (√ हृ), non-removal

v: anudData
tri॰ na udDataH viroDe na॰ ta॰ । vinayayukte ।
m: अन्-उद्धत mfn. (√ हन्), not lifted up, humble
unsurpassed
unopposed
अन्-उद्धत m. not a high place, TBr.
a: अनुद्धत — a. Not raised or puffed up; ˚ताः सत्पुरुषाः समृद्धिभिः Ś. 5. 12; humble; modest; unsurpassed.

m: अन्-उद्धृताभ्यस्तमय m. sunset (अभ्य्-अस्तमय) taking place whilst the Āhavanīya fire continues unremoved from the Gārhapatya, KātyŚr.

tri॰ na udDftamutTApitam । anutTApite “payo'nudDftasAraYceti” havizyavizaye smftiH ।
m: अन्-उद्धृत mfn. non-removed, not taken away
uninjured, undestroyed
unoffered
undivided, unpartitioned
unestablished, unproved.
a: अनुद्धृत — a. Undivided, unremoved, uninjured, unharmed, undestroyed, unoffered or established &c. --Comp. --अभ्यस्तमयः taking place of sunset, while the आहवनीय fire continues to be unremoved from the गार्हपत्य.

m: अनु-दैर्घ्य mfn. longitudinal.
a: अनुदैर्घ्य — a. [दैर्घ्यमनुगतः] Longitudinal, lengthwise.

m: अनु-√ दॄ Pass. -दीर्यते, to break through after (another); to be scattered or confused in consequence of the confusion of others.
अन्-उद्घात m. no blow or jolt or jerk, Kālid.

v: anuda
tri॰ na nudati nuda--ka na॰ ta॰ । prerakaBinne anudadAti tulyaM dadAti anu + dA ka । tulyarUpadAtari etasya udAharaRam prAguktre anAnudaSabde dfSyam ।
m: अनु-द See अनानुद.

m: अनु-दण्डि f. back bone, MBh.

not projecting.

v: anudaka

m: अन्-उदक mf(आ)n. waterless, RV. vii, 50, 4, &c.
a: अनुदक — a. 1 Waterless(as a desert). --2 Having very little water (as a puddle). --3 Devoid of the libations of water (a sort of श्राद्ध).

m: अन्-उदकम् (अम्), ind. without touching water, KātyŚr.
without adding water, ib.
अन्-उद-पान n. ‘non-water-drinking’, thirst, BhP.
अनु-दर्श m. representation, admonition, MBh.

m: अनु-दर्शिन् mfn. considering, foreseeing.

m: अनु-दत्त mfn. granted, remitted, given back, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 47 Comm.
अन्-उदय m. non-rising, the not rising (of a luminary).

v: anuddeSa
pu॰ na uddeSaH aBAvArTe na॰ ta॰ । uddeSABAve ।
anudeSa
pu॰ anu + diSa--GaY । yaTAkramoccAraRe, upadeSe ca “yaTAsaMKyamanudeSaH samAnAmiti” pA॰ । anudiSyate karmaRi GaY । upadeSye “anudeSAdyAH puroqASetyAdi” kAtyA॰ 18, 6, 15 ।
m: अनु-देश m. a rule or injunction pointing back to a previous rule

I. 3. 10; subsequent mention of things (words, suffixes &c.) in the order of things previously mentioned, respective enumeration or statement, first for first, second for second; as in समूलाकृतजीवेषु हन्कृञ्ग्रहः P. III. 4. 36. --2 Direction, order, injunction.

being the object of an Anudeśa

अनु-देयी f. a bride's maid (Gmn. and Sāy.), RV. x, 85, 6; 135, 5 and 6
[‘gift’, NBD.]
a: अनुदेयी — 1 Restoration. --2 A female companion.

m: अनु-देय n. a present, RV. vi, 20, 11
अनु-√ दृभ् to make into bundles or chains, KauṣBr.

अनु-√ दृश् (ind.p. -दृश्य, RV. x, 130, 7) to survey, behold; to keep in view or in mind, to foresee: Caus. P. -दर्शयति, to show, tell, teach: Pass. -दृश्यते (also perf. Ā. -ददृशे, RV. viii, 1, 34), to become or be visible.
a: अनुदृश् — {c1c} P. To survey, behold; to keep in view or mind, see in prospect; न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे Bg. 1. 31; Bh. 3. 3. --Caus. To show, tell, inform as follows; सेनापतिः पुत्रमग्निमित्रं परिष्वज्य अनुदर्शयति M. 5 writes or informs as follows.

अनु-दिग्ध mfn. (√ दिह्), covered (ifc.), Car.

accompanied
